name: wyqd-app

scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:obsidian && npm run build:extension
scripts.validate:obsidian: npm run check:obsidian && npm run lint:obsidian && npm run package:obsidian && node scripts/validate-obsidian-release.mjs
scripts.validate:extension: node scripts/validate-extension-manifest.mjs && npm run build:extension && vitest run src/domain/planner.test.ts src/extension/utils.test.ts src/extension/saved-list-match.test.ts src/extension/place-parser.test.ts src/extension/capture-state.test.ts src/extension/currency-detector.test.ts src/extension/enrichment.test.ts
scripts.validate:fast: node scripts/gen-git-sha.mjs && tsc --noEmit && npm run lint && npm run validate:terminology && npm run validate:membership
scripts.validate:shared: npm test && npm run validate:runtime-parity && npm run test:e2e:data && npm run test:cli && npm run test:mcp && npm run test:planner && npm run test:onboarding && npm run test:portability && npm run test:runtime-parity
scripts.validate:web: npm run build && npm run validate:pages
scripts.validate: npm run validate:fast && npm run validate:shared && npm run validate:web && npm run validate:obsidian && npm run validate:extension
scripts.validate:pages: node scripts/validate-static-export.mjs && node scripts/validate-pwa.mjs && vitest run src/services/ownly-data-layout.test.ts
scripts.smoke:install: python -m pip install -r requirements-smoke.txt && python -m playwright install chromium
scripts.test:e2e: npm run smoke:web && npm run smoke:site
scripts.test:planner: vitest run src/domain/planner.test.ts src/domain/planner-schedule.test.ts src/domain/planner-route-time.test.ts src/services/PlannerRepository.schedule.test.ts src/services/PlannerRepository.thailand-golden-path.test.ts src/services/PlannerRepository.lifecycle.test.ts src/services/PlannerRepository.idempotency.test.ts src/services/PlannerRepository.doctor.test.ts src/services/PlannerRepository.capture-to-planner-e2e.test.ts src/services/golden-dataset.test.ts
scripts.test:mcp: node packages/mcp/build.mjs && vitest run src/domain/planner-schedule.test.ts src/domain/planner-route-time.test.ts src/services/PlannerRepository.schedule.test.ts src/services/PlannerRepository.thailand-golden-path.test.ts scripts/mcp/ownly-tools.test.ts scripts/mcp/openrouteservice.test.ts scripts/shared/ownly-write-service.test.ts scripts/mcp/ownly-mcp.process.test.ts

description: Local-first ownership memory and decision ledger with portable Markdown data.
